cases.name: Isabella Rose Salas
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Isabella was a senior at Cranford High School, where she was very involved with several clubs and organizations. She was a very talented singer with the voice of an angel. She was a member of the Celebration Singers Choir, Cranford High School Concert Choir, and an acapella group. She was especially passionate with theater, as she was a part of many plays through Hillside Avenue School and Cranford High School, as well as Cranford Dramatic Club Theater. She was kind, generous, gentle, and will forever be deeply loved by her family."

cases.name: Maria Niotis
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Born in Rhodes, Greece she was a lifelong resident of Cranford. She was a student of Cranford High School and employee of Cake Artist Café. She aspired to graduate high school and start a cosmetology career."
